scenarios.name: cli_headless_no_move_and_error_output
scenarios.title: Start headless, click a visible control without moving, verify trusted input and stdout
scenarios.workflow: Invalid launch mode -> correct mode -> navigate -> locate -> no-move click -> verify UI and stdout -> close
scenarios.user_problem: An agent must be able to launch with boolean or named headless modes and observe the result of --no-move in a fresh CLI process, including failures.

scenarios.name: real_extension_routing_diagnostics_and_worker_restart
scenarios.title: Drive a real extension across independent calls and a forced worker restart
scenarios.workflow: Connect -> inspect extension -> navigate -> trusted click -> screenshot -> stop/start worker -> reconnect -> verify same tab and UI
scenarios.user_problem: Browser-level discovery can succeed while page routing loses the target ID. The extension must drive the correct tab on legacy and asyncio WebSockets and recover its owned tabs after a worker restart.
